[P2] Provide evidence for the AgentCore state guarantees

CONTRIBUTING rule 6 requires evidence for external-service assumptions or an explicit `unverified` label in the PR description. The description reports only a build and local worker tests, which cannot establish AgentCore's process affinity or instance-replacement behavior. These guarantees affect workflows that depend on earlier jobs' files and memory. Return to the design phase under rule 9: cite relevant service documentation or live-run evidence, or mark the unsupported assumptions `unverified` in the description.
